core_obligations: Take the associated points of the generic fibre outside the open and spread their closures to a neighbourhood.
Show that over a nonempty open the traces of those closures remain outside the given open in every fibre.

proof_roadmap.step: Identify the associated points outside the open on the generic fibre.
Spread their closures over a neighbourhood.

difficulty_reason: For a finite type morphism over an irreducible base and a finitely type module, if the associated points of the generic fibre are not contained in a given open, then the same failure holds for every fibre over a nonempty open. The proof argues through the closures of the associated points outside the open, spreads those closures to a neighbourhood using finite type and irreducibility, and shows the traces still avoid the open fibrewise. Keeping the spread closures outside the open is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 6923-6938.
